name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1866: His journal holds 414 rows written under the stub seam across ten days, beside real ones, with nothing to tell them apart except a mode field the summary rows do not carry. While MINI was dead he pressed buttons and the log shows five starts in 64 seconds alternating sim and live, so he reported a live session that had actually read canned frames whose scene always defaults to gameplay. The console believed it filtered simulations out; the flag it filtered on means a one-read ghost with no footage. Every simulated row now stamps itself, the payload carries it, and the today row counts runs and simulations apart and says so.
